home.headline: Red House Trading: Building Foundations, Delivering Excellence Since 1999.
home.sub: Rooted in Jeddah and trusted across KSA for over two decades, Red House delivers market-leading solutions across trading, contracting, professional catering, and digital services. We combine long-standing local expertise with modern execution to power your business growth.

about.legacy: Established in 1999, Red House began its journey with a singular commitment to quality and integrity. Over the past two decades, our core success has been deeply tied to the growth of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, where we have built an unshakeable reputation as a premier multi-divisional partner. From our historical foundations in trading and contracting to our digital evolutionary steps, we have consistently moved alongside Vision 2030 to empower local businesses, industries, and communities.
about.next: Building directly upon the culinary reputation and operational excellence of our established, high-end dining restaurant, Red House has proudly launched its specialized Food Catering Division. This milestone marks the beginning of our grand forward-looking expansion strategy.
about.future: At Red House, we are thinking big. Our immediate roadmap focuses on scaling our industrial, corporate, and event catering services across the entire Western Region of KSA. By scaling our infrastructure, supply lines, and central kitchens from Jeddah outward, we aim to become the premier hospitality and food service partner for major developments, corporate sectors, and mega-projects across the West Coast.
about.mission: To deliver high-quality trading, contracting, and catering services across KSA using modern digital systems and local Saudi talent.
about.vision: To expand from our Jeddah stronghold and become the leading multi-sector service enterprise across Western Saudi Arabia.
